title: 第2279章 混沌小世界第2278章 行不通
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
“既然没什么价值，那都去死吧。”
神主抬手对着虚空一抓，玄冥帆以极快速度缩小，随即落入了他手中。
只见神主一挥手，玄冥帆带起了一阵黑色狂风，那狂风撕裂虚空，直奔一众禁忌生灵幸存强者而去。
“不……不要……”
面对迎面而来的狂风，禁忌生灵强者感受到死亡威胁，口中发出凄厉叫喊声，他们挣扎着不断后退，然而狂风却越来越近。
“为……为什么，为什么禁主不出手，难道他放弃我们了吗？”
眼见禁天没有做出任何回应，其中一名禁忌生灵强者发出质疑，言语中满是绝望。
其余人闻言也是一脸崩溃，他们在这里拼死拼活，没想到却被放弃了，内心不免一阵悲凉。
“轰隆隆！”
可就当黑色狂风即将碰到众人时，天穹上空突然电闪雷鸣，大量幽冥之气席卷而来，瞬间将这方天地填满。
“刺啦…”
虚空一分为二，禁天从裂缝踏出，此时的他身穿黑色铠甲，一身气息强得可怕。
“凝！”
禁天淡淡吐出一个字，黑色狂风便被定在原地，而后只见他隔空一握拳，黑色狂风直接被捏碎。
“禁主……是禁主，他没有放弃我等。”
“恭迎禁主！”
看到禁天的瞬间，一众禁忌生灵族人面露狂喜之色，而后他们齐声开口。
就连身受重伤的灵玄机，此时也是面露笑意，紧绷的身躯放松了不少。
禁天带来了大量幽冥之气，灵玄机身躯正在贪婪吸收，有了幽冥之气加持，他身上伤势正在快速恢复。
原本抬一下手指都费力的他，如今已能艰难活动，周身疼痛感更是消散大半。

……
“咦？”
神族眼见禁天出现，口中顿时发出一阵轻咦声，本以为自己的计划失败了，没想到最终还是将对方给引出来了。
禁天缓缓低头，锐利的目光锁定神主。
沉声质问：“我禁忌生灵一族与生灵族向来井水不犯河水，你为何对唔族出手？”
面对禁天的质问，神主微微一笑，傲然开口回应：“自然是为了资源，只有拿到禁忌生灵一族资源，我才能完成突破。”
“你若识趣一点交出资源，本帝可自行离去，倘若不愿意，我只能自行出手了。”
一听神主目标是本族资源，禁天脸色骤然一声，怒呵道：“狂妄！”
“想染指唔族资源，你这是痴心妄想。”
禁天态度十分坚决，断然不会将资源交给神主，毕竟他已触碰到突破边缘。
若不是因为神主的突然出现，他怕是已在冲击神帝境。
神主对此早有预料，因此听到禁天这个回复也不恼怒，他缓缓抬起玄冥帆。
寒声开口：“看来还是得自己动手，就拿你试一试玄冥帆的威力吧，此帆可是本帝特意为禁忌生灵一族准备的。”
“刷刷刷！”
话音一落，神主不断挥动玄冥帆，几个呼吸之间，便将周遭幽冥之气尽数吞噬。
content_en:
"Since it's of no value, let's all die."
The God Lord raised his hand and grabbed the void. Xuan Ming Sail shrunk at a very fast speed and then fell into his hands.
The Divine Lord waved his hand, and Xuan Ming Sail brought up a black gust of wind. The gust of wind tore through the void and headed straight for the survivors of the forbidden creatures.
"No...don't..."
Facing the oncoming strong wind, the forbidden creatures felt the threat of death and let out shrill screams. They struggled and kept retreating, but the strong wind was getting closer and closer.
"Why...why, why doesn't the Forbidden Lord take action? Has he given up on us?"
Seeing that Forbidden Sky did not make any response, one of the Forbidden Creatures experts questioned, his words full of despair.
The rest of the people also looked broken when they heard this. They worked hard here, but unexpectedly they were given up, and they couldn't help but feel sad in their hearts.
"Boom!"
But just when the black wind was about to hit everyone, there was sudden lightning and thunder in the sky, and a large amount of netherworld energy swept in, filling the whole world in an instant.
"Stab it..."
The void was split into two, and Forbidden Sky stepped out of the crack. At this time, he was wearing black armor, and his aura was terrifyingly strong.
"Condensation!"
Jin Tian faintly uttered a word, and the black gale was frozen in place. Then he made a fist in the air, and the black gale was crushed directly.
"The Forbidden Lord...is the Forbidden Lord. He has not given up on us."
"Welcome the Forbidden Lord!"
The moment they saw Forbidden Heaven, the faces of the Forbidden Creatures tribe showed expressions of ecstasy, and then they spoke in unison.
Even Ling Xuanji, who was seriously injured, was smiling at this time, and his tense body relaxed a lot.
Forbidden Sky has brought a large amount of Netherworld Qi, and Lingxuanji's body is greedily absorbing it. With the blessing of Netherworld Qi, his injuries are recovering quickly.
He used to have difficulty lifting his fingers, but now he can move with difficulty, and most of the pain in his body has dissipated.
…
"Huh?"
When the Gods saw Jin Tian appear, they suddenly let out a soft sigh. They thought their plan had failed, but they didn't expect that they would eventually lead the opponent out.
Jintian lowered his head slowly, his sharp eyes locked on the Divine Lord.
He asked in a deep voice: "My Taboo Creature Clan and the Creature Clan have never been in conflict with each other. Why did you take action against the Hu Clan?"
Faced with Forbidden Sky's question, the Divine Lord smiled slightly and responded proudly: "Of course it is for resources. Only by obtaining the resources of the Forbidden Creature Clan can I complete the breakthrough."
"If you are wise and hand over the resources, I can leave on my own. If you don't want to, I can only take action on my own."
Upon hearing that the God Lord was targeting his own clan's resources, Ji Tian's expression suddenly changed and he shouted angrily: "Arrogant!"
"You want to get your hands on the resources of the Hu tribe, but you are wishful thinking."
Jin Tian's attitude is very resolute and he will definitely not give resources to the God Lord. After all, he has reached the edge of breakthrough.
If it weren't for the sudden appearance of the God Lord, he might have already been attacking the God Emperor Realm.
The Lord God had expected this, so he was not angry when he heard Ji Tian's reply. He slowly raised the Xuan Ming Sail.
Han Sheng said: "It seems that I still have to do it myself. Let me try the power of Xuan Ming Sail with you. This sail is specially prepared by this emperor for the forbidden creatures."
"Swish, swish, swish!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the God Lord kept waving the Xuanming Sail, and in a few breaths, he swallowed up all the surrounding Netherworld energy.
